title: Decision request
description: Body of POST /v1/decisions. Requests are validated strictly: unknown properties are rejected so that an integration mistake is visible instead of silent.

subject_id.description: Optional anonymous subject. Without it a decision is still returned; only subject-level stability and multi-session attribution are unavailable.

eligible_alternatives.description: Alternatives the caller declares eligible. Must be a subset of the tenant's configured alternatives for this placement.
